name: std-learn-scenario
description: Generic branching decision scenario — a config-declared node graph of situations and choices plays out as a choose-your-path story with modeled consequences: every choice shifts two config-named metrics, appends to a visible decision log, and moves to its declared next node, until a node with no choices ends the run with the final metrics and the full path. This simulates decisions rather than browsing records: the learner feels trade-offs compound. All vocabulary is config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any consequence-chain lesson: fiscal policy choices, ecosystem interventions, historical what-ifs, medical triage, engineering trade-offs. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

metricALabel.description: Display name of the first tracked consequence metric.
metricALabel.label: Metric A Label

metricBLabel.description: Display name of the second tracked consequence metric.
metricBLabel.label: Metric B Label

choices.label: Build a levee now
choices.note: Fast protection, most of the budget gone.

choices.label: Restore the upstream wetlands
choices.note: Cheaper and greener, but slower to work.

default.situation: Your town's river floods every spring. The council asks you to lead the response.

choices.label: Raise the levee again
choices.note: Costs keep compounding.

choices.label: Add wetlands as a second line
choices.note: Late, but it eases the pressure.

default.situation: The levee holds the first spring, but silt builds up and the river rises higher each year.

choices.label: Expand the wetland corridor
choices.note: The town rallies behind the project.

choices.label: Bank the savings
choices.note: Prudent, though the corridor stays small.

default.situation: Two springs pass; the wetlands now absorb most floods, and wildlife is returning.
You are locked into an arms race with the river: protected, but at ever-growing cost.
The hybrid defense works: the levee buys time and the wetlands cut the peak floods.
The restored river corridor protects the town and becomes its most loved public space.
The town stays safe in normal years, with savings in reserve for a bigger flood.

nodes.description: The decision graph; each node carries a situation and its choices, each choice naming the next node, metric deltas, and a consequence note. A node with no choices ends the run. Realizations declare their own subject's decision tree here.
nodes.label: Nodes

startId.description: Id of the node the scenario opens on.
startId.label: Start Node

emits.description: A decision was taken: the node reached, both metric values after the deltas, and whether the run just ended — a composed listener (coach, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: branching scenario, choose your path, decision tree, consequences, trade-offs, what-if

emits.description: The learner restarted the scenario from scratch.

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected

events.description: Learner picked one of the current node's choices — index selects it; its metric deltas apply, the decision log grows, and the story moves to the declared next node.
events.name: Choose

events.description: Learner restarted the scenario from the start node with fresh metrics and an empty decision log.
events.name: Restart

events.description: A decision was taken: the node reached, both metric values after the deltas, and whether the run just ended — a composed listener (coach, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.name: Choice Made
events.synonyms: branching scenario, choose your path, decision tree, consequences, trade-offs, what-if

events.description: The learner restarted the scenario from scratch.
events.name: Scenario Restarted
